missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Труп' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'лежал'. 'Холодный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'на полу' is a prepositional location phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. Although труп refers to a body, it is grammatically inanimate, so the accusative 'труп' matches the nominative. 'В реке' adds a prepositional location.

missions.phrase: Рядом с трупом не было следов.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Instrumental after с. The phrase 'рядом с' takes the instrumental 'трупом'. 'Не было следов' adds a genitive-plural of absence in the past tense.
Strategic focus: Genitive after около. The preposition 'около' meaning near requires the genitive 'трупа'. 'Двое мужчин' is a collective numeral with genitive plural.
Strategic focus: Dative after к. The preposition 'к' governs the dative, giving 'трупу', to express approach. 'Осторожно' is an adverb of manner.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. After 'на' the noun takes the prepositional 'трупе'. 'Старую рану' is the feminine accusative object of 'нашли'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. The grammatically inanimate 'труп' takes the accusative identical to the nominative as the object of 'осмотрел'. 'Внимательно' adds the manner.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after два. The numeral 'два' requires the genitive singular 'трупа'. 'В подвале' is a prepositional location setting the scene.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Трупы' is the accusative plural object of 'увезли'; as a grammatically inanimate noun it matches the nominative plural. 'Эти' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after много. The quantity word 'много' requires the genitive plural 'трупов'. 'Неопознанных' is the agreeing genitive-plural adjective.
